sections.title: Text 1

blocks.zh: 陈天中：李文，期中考试后就再也没见过你了，你这段时间在忙什么呢？
blocks.en: Chen Tianzhong: Li Wen, I haven’t seen you since the midterms. What have you been busy with?

blocks.zh: 李文：我最近去一家医药公司应聘了，他们正在招聘实习生。
blocks.en: Li Wen: I applied to a pharmaceutical company recruiting interns.

blocks.zh: 陈天中：你这么早就考虑实习了？
blocks.en: Chen: Are you considering an internship so early?

blocks.zh: 李文：现在很多单位在招聘毕业生时，都很重视有没有实习经历，所以我想提前去锻炼一下，积累一些经验。
blocks.en: Li: Many employers value internship experience when hiring graduates, so I want to gain experience early.

blocks.zh: 陈天中：那现在有结果了吗？
blocks.en: Chen: Do you have a result yet?

blocks.zh: 李文：我还在等消息，希望能有好结果。
blocks.en: Li: I’m still waiting for news and hoping for a good result.

blocks.zh: 李文为什么现在就想去实习？
blocks.en: Why does Li want an internship now?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

answers.zh: 因为很多单位重视实习经历，他想提前积累经验。
answers.en: Employers value internships and he wants early experience.

blocks.zh: 李文应聘成功了吗？
blocks.en: Was his application successful?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 2

answers.zh: 还不知道，他正在等消息。
answers.en: He does not know yet; he is waiting for news.

sections.note: Retell this text in your own words

prompt.zh: 陈天中很久没有……。他问李文这段时间……。李文说他最近去……，因为那家公司……。他觉得现在很多单位在……时，都很重视……，所以他想提前……，积累……。陈天中又问李文现在……。李文说他还在……，希望……。
prompt.en: Retell why Li applied, why internships matter, and why he is still waiting.

answer.zh: 陈天中很久没有见过李文，问他最近忙什么。李文说，他去一家招聘实习生的医药公司应聘了。很多单位招聘毕业生时重视实习经历，所以他想提前锻炼，积累经验。他现在还在等消息，希望有好结果。
answer.en: Chen had not seen Li for a long time and asked about his activities. Li had applied to a pharmaceutical company recruiting interns. Employers value experience, so he wanted to gain it early. He was still waiting and hoping for good news.

sections.title: Text 2

blocks.zh: 陈天中：李文，你是怎么应聘的？
blocks.en: Chen: Li, how did you apply?

blocks.zh: 李文：我先在网上报名，填写个人信息，然后等公司通知我去参加笔试。
blocks.en: Li: I registered online and filled in personal details, then waited for the company to invite me to a written exam.

blocks.zh: 陈天中：笔试都考些什么？
blocks.en: Chen: What did the written exam test?

blocks.zh: 李文：主要是一些专业知识。考完没多久，他们就让我去面试了。
blocks.en: Li: Mainly professional knowledge. Soon afterward they invited me to an interview.

blocks.zh: 陈天中：看来你笔试答得不错，那你面试得怎么样？
blocks.en: Chen: Your written answers must have been good. How was the interview?

blocks.zh: 李文：那天是由部门负责人来面试的，我有点儿紧张。他让我介绍了自己的学习经历、兴趣爱好和对工作的想法。
blocks.en: Li: The department head interviewed me. I was nervous. He asked about my education, interests and ideas about work.

blocks.zh: 陈天中：听起来挺正式的。
blocks.en: Chen: It sounds formal.

blocks.zh: 李文：是啊，我觉得这次经历很有用。不论结果怎么样，对我以后找工作肯定有帮助。
blocks.en: Li: Yes. It was useful. Whatever the result, it will certainly help my future job search.

blocks.zh: 李文面试的内容是什么？
blocks.en: What did Li discuss in the interview?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

answers.zh: 他介绍了学习经历、兴趣爱好和对工作的想法。
answers.en: His education, interests and ideas about work.

blocks.zh: 李文觉得这次应聘经历怎么样？
blocks.en: How does Li feel about the application experience?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 2

answers.zh: 很有用，不论结果怎么样，都对以后找工作有帮助。
answers.en: It is useful and will help future job hunting regardless of the result.

sections.title: Text 3

blocks.zh: 一天下午，李文突然收到一条短信，说他通过了面试，让他下周一到公司实习。李文看到信息后，激动得把手机扔到床上，在屋子里跳了起来。之后的几天，李文忙着做各种准备。为了给大家留个好印象，他去理发店把头发理了理，又去商店买了一身正式的衣服，还打算在镜子前把自我介绍练一练。
blocks.en: One afternoon Li received a text saying he had passed the interview and should start his internship next Monday. He was so excited that he threw his phone onto the bed and jumped around. Over the following days he prepared: a haircut, a formal outfit and plans to rehearse his self-introduction in front of a mirror.

blocks.zh: 在他看来，这次实习是一个新的开始。他希望不仅能够运用专业知识完成任务，还能够积累更多经验，为将来找工作打下基础。
blocks.en: He saw the internship as a new beginning. He hoped to apply his professional knowledge, complete tasks and gain experience to build a foundation for future work.

blocks.zh: 李文看到信息后做什么了？
blocks.en: What did Li do after reading the message?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

answers.zh: 他激动得把手机扔到床上，在屋子里跳了起来。
answers.en: He threw his phone onto the bed and jumped excitedly.

blocks.zh: 李文是怎么看这次实习的？
blocks.en: How did Li view the internship?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 2

answers.zh: 他觉得这是新的开始，可以运用知识、积累经验，为找工作打基础。
answers.en: As a new beginning to apply knowledge and gain experience for future employment.

prompt.en: Retell the message, Li’s reaction and preparations, and his hopes for the internship.

answer.zh: 李文收到短信，知道自己通过了面试，下周一可以去公司实习。他很激动，把手机扔到床上，在屋子里跳了起来。他去理发，买了正式的衣服，还准备在镜子前练习自我介绍。他觉得实习是新的开始，希望运用专业知识，积累经验，为将来找工作打下基础。
answer.en: Li learned that he had passed the interview and would start on Monday. He threw his phone onto the bed and jumped with excitement. He got a haircut, bought formal clothes and planned to rehearse his introduction. He hoped to use his knowledge and gain experience for future work.

sections.title: Text 4

blocks.zh: 在中国，很多大学生在毕业前都会去实习。实习的地方有公司、工厂，也有学校和医院。学生们通过实习，可以积累工作经验，熟悉工作内容和单位的管理规定，提前了解并适应社会。
blocks.en: Many Chinese university students intern before graduation at companies, factories, schools or hospitals. Internships help them gain experience, learn tasks and workplace rules, and understand and adapt to society.

blocks.zh: 在实习中，学生常常会发现，课堂上学到的知识和实际工作并不完全一样。例如：有些事情，在课本上学不如自己做一遍，因为只有在做的时候，才会发现有很多细节需要注意；还有一些问题，在书上找不到答案，只能通过日常工作慢慢理解。在这样的过程中，学生能够对学到的知识有更好的认识，也更清楚自己的职业发展方向。
blocks.en: Students often discover that classroom knowledge and real work differ. Some things are better learned by doing because details emerge only in practice. Other problems have no textbook answer and become clear through daily work. This improves students’ understanding and clarifies their career direction.

blocks.zh: 通过实习，学生可以学到什么？
blocks.en: What can students learn from internships?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

answers.zh: 可以积累经验，了解工作内容和规定，适应社会，明确职业方向。
answers.en: They gain experience, learn duties and rules, adapt to society and clarify career goals.

blocks.zh: 为什么说有些事情需要自己做一遍？
blocks.en: Why should some things be tried personally?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 2

answers.zh: 只有在做的时候，才会发现需要注意的细节。
answers.en: Only practice reveals details that need attention.

blocks.zh: 你的一个朋友要去一家国际公司应聘。请给他／她写一份应聘建议清单，不少于140字。
blocks.en: Write at least 140 Chinese characters of application advice for a friend applying to an international company.
blocks.heading: Writing · at least 140 characters

answers.zh: 听说你准备去一家国际公司应聘，我想给你一些建议。首先，你应该提前了解公司的情况，看看这个工作需要什么能力，再认真填写个人信息。其次，准备好自我介绍，把自己的学习经历和实习经历说清楚。你可以在镜子前练一练，也可以请朋友听一听。面试那天，要穿合适的衣服，按时到，不要让负责人等你。回答问题时，先认真听，再说明自己的想法。如果有不懂的地方，可以有礼貌地问一问。不论最后的结果怎么样，这次经历都会帮助你了解自己，为以后找工作积累经验。
answers.en: Research the company and required abilities, complete personal information carefully and prepare a clear introduction covering education and internships. Rehearse in a mirror or with a friend. Dress suitably and arrive on time. Listen before answering and ask politely when unsure. Whatever the outcome, the experience will help you understand yourself and prepare for future job hunting.
